headline: Hitachi Energy India Limited: QIP Monitoring Agency Report (Q1 FY2026-27)
sum: Hitachi Energy India filed its Regulation 32(6) Monitoring Agency report on use of QIP proceeds for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The report represents compliance disclosure post a Qualified Institutional Placement capital raise.
detail: Hitachi Energy India Limited, the listed power-systems and renewable-energy subsidiary of Japan's Hitachi group, filed a statutory Monitoring Agency (MA) report with the NSE covering Q1 FY2026-27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026). Under Regulation 32(6) of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, a QIP issuer must furnish periodic certification from an independent monitoring agency confirming end-use compliance. The report demonstrates the company's adherence to disclosed use-of-proceeds undertakings.
